note: Custer Gallatin NF (Yellowstone RD), on the Boulder River 21 mi south of McLeod on the Main Boulder Road (County Rd 212), ~5,500 ft, near the Absaroka-Beartooth Wilderness. Narrow gravel access road with no turnaround; the Forest Service says travel with a trailer is not recommended south of Hells Canyon (this campground is south of it) and to call the district office for road conditions. Bear boxes. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 1, 2026) confirms $12 (+$5 extra vehicle), 12 sites, vault toilet, no potable water; changed status unknown -> temporarily_closed ('Closed under Special Order'), added season year_round (Seasons of Use 'All Year', snow-limited access), max_rig_ft 32 (access-road limit). Booking (derived FCFS) left: the page has no reservations section. Note's 'largest spur ~24 ft' was the spur width (24' x 51') and '21 mi S of Hells Canyon' was the distance up the Main Boulder Rd; both corrected.
flags: Status: FS page Current Conditions reads 'Closed under Special Order' (page updated May 1, 2026; a web search shows the same status since at least July 2025). No matching order is on https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/alerts and no reason or reopening date is given. Recorded temporarily_closed; a human should confirm with the Yellowstone Ranger District (406-222-1892).

Access caveat (explicit, trailers): 'Travel with a trailer is not recommended south of Hells Canyon' and 'Access road not suitable for vehicles longer than 32''; Hick's Park is south of Hells Canyon. A 23-ft motorhome is under the 32-ft limit, but a human may want to judge the road.
